prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for all situations — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, how soon you need service, whether you want a low price or a strong warranty, and whether it’s a simple repair or a major replacement. That said, several well-regarded options that serve Houston (local branches/franchises vary) are commonly recommended:

- John Moore Services (Houston-based, large local presence)  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (national chain with big Houston footprint)  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (franchise with Houston service)  
- Service Experts (national chain with local techs)

How to pick the best one for your situation
- Check licensing and insurance: verify they’re licensed to do HVAC work in Texas and carry liability insurance.  
- Look for EPA 608 certification (required to handle refrigerants) and NATE-certified techs.  
- Read recent Google/BBB/Angi/HomeAdvisor reviews for your ZIP code (look for patterns, not just single bad reviews).  
- Ask about warranties (parts and labor), guarantees, and whether they use OEM or aftermarket parts.  
- Get at least 2–3 written estimates before agreeing to repairs or a replacement.  
- Ask about emergency/after-hours fees if you need same-day service.

Questions to ask during the call
- Do you charge a diagnostic fee (how much)?  
- Are your techs licensed and NATE-certified?  
- What’s included in the estimate (parts, labor, trip charges)?  
- Do you offer any warranties, and how long?  
- Can you provide references or recent local reviews?

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether it’s an emergency (no cool air right now) or a planned repair, and I’ll pull up the highest-rated companies near you and their recent ratings so you can compare.
